name: Lustin
source: A prince from a small country. He has a carefree personality, and unbound by anything, he often sneaks out of the dormitory to indulge in the nightlife. He was sent to Nirvana in hopes of enhancing his military prowess for his country. He dislikes combat and prefers glamorous and enjoyable activities, yet his abilities are among the top in Nirvana.
